integrity: All proof assertions are limited to the stated finite degree-one class; the exact value follows from the stable-phase correspondence and a three-bin partition identity.
scientific_limitations: Only finite attack graphs of maximum indegree and outdegree one with no odd directed cycles and at least two even cycles.
Published pairwise diversity and general weighted-Hamming optimization do not themselves supply the exact three-way formula; equivalent treatment under other terminology remains a priority risk.
Finite enumeration of 35 cases is supplemental; correctness rests on a full structural proof.
title: Exact three-viewpoint stable-extension diversity for degree-one argumentation graphs
